spans.s:
सेकः [सिच्-घञ्]
1 Sprinkling,
watering (trees); सेकः सीकरिणा
करेण विहितः कामं

.
--2 Emission,
effusion.
--3 Seminal effusion.
--4
A libation, an offering.
--5 Seminal
fluid.
--6 A drop of anything.
--Comp.
--पात्रं {1} a pot for sprinkling water,
a watering-pot. {2} a bucket.

सेक्तृ a. (क्त्री f.) One who sprinkles
&c. --m.
1 A sprinkler.
--2 A
husband.
--3 A water-bearer.
